'''Ril''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He was stationed in [[Outpost Senth]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
